record.reason: ReMoE replaces TopK+Softmax with differentiable ReLU routing and dynamically allocates experts. Its central motivation and experiments focus on differentiability and training scalability; it reports inference throughput within −2.29% to +3.89% of conventional TopK MoE, i.e. roughly comparable speed rather than an inference-efficiency gain. Relevant MoE serving architecture, but evidence does not show inference reduction as its primary objective.
record.title: ReMoE: Fully Differentiable Mixture-of-Experts with ReLU Routing
